Our History

Built on trust. Proven by time. Driven for tomorrow.

BWR had a humble beginning starting as a small-time manufacturer in Mumbai India, with a core focus on quality and innovation. Since inception these ethos were ingrained in the team and BWR stands tall on this very commitment. BWR is a result of razor like focus, imbibing the Indian culture derived from our very name Bharat which means “India” and a penchant for innovation and technology.
